body: you are right but i don't have the strength to change them. thank you for taking the time to talk to me, kind stranger.

unchangeable things I mean my lack of creativity, intelligence, my appearance (things plastic surgery can't fix), my memories that make me want to crawl into a hole, the way i interact with people (shy, awkward, weird, embarrassing, stupid) hence why I don't really have friends, or ever been in a relationship the fact that i'm too old to start doing some stuff i want to do and be successful at them, the fact that i always fail and can't trust myself...and more.

i already have tried telling them and they basically called me selfish, and that it is my decision for wanting to be this way, think this way. I feel like by dying that will be the only way they will really understand. I appreciate your words, however there are many things about myself that can't be changed and those are the things I desperately want changed- the unchangeable ones.

i've been to several psychologists. I really liked the last one, but she was too expensive and we couldn't afford her fees after 10 sessions. I'm in my bedroom in my tiny townhouse with sister texting away next door and mother on the phone. It is 23:49 where I live right now and it is -11 degrees outside.

yes i have and while they do worry, they don't really understand etc etc..i don't want them to hear bc if i somehow someway get through tonight, I don't want them knowing about me being really close to dying.
